summary: Hongli Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. The company received a notification from Nasdaq on August 7, 2026, after its Class A ordinary shares closed at $1.00 or above for 10 consecutive business days from July 24 to August 6, 2026. This follows a deficiency notice received on July 2, 2026. The filing is a routine compliance update and contains no special-situation transaction. No deal terms, board actions, or advisors are mentioned. Watch for continued listing compliance and any future capital actions.
